summary: Re-tested horizontal tab chip fix on /my-orders and /merchant-orders at 390x844 mobile viewport. Both pages now render a compact horizontal tab row (chip height ~33px) instead of the previously-reported tall vertical bars. No Expo Router unmatched-route fallback.
